name: gateway-telegram
description: Telegram bot gateway. Long-poll the Telegram Bot API and forward each inbound message to `cos agent ask`, replying with the response. Stdlib-only — no third-party Python deps required.

commands.start: Start the long-poll loop in the foreground (run under `cos service` for daemonization)
commands.status: Show running state + last update_id offset + state-dir path
commands.send: Send a one-shot message to a chat id (positional: chat_id text)
